parts.text: JUST FILED: $SYY 8-K filed Nov 3 — results of operations (earnings): “SYSCO NAMES BRANDON SEWELL CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER Company reaffirms fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS and local volume guidance HOUSTON, November 3, 2026 - …” How do you read it? #8K #earnings

What the filing says
“SYSCO NAMES BRANDON SEWELL CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER Company reaffirms fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS and local volume guidance HOUSTON, November 3, 2026 - Sysco Corporation (NYSE:SYY) (“Sysco” or the “company”) today announced that Brandon …
… Sewell, the Company’s Interim Chief Financial Officer since March 2026, has been named Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective November 1, 2026.”
The filing: 8-K Item 2.02 (results of operations (earnings)), filed 2026-11-03.
Charts: $SYY Q1 FY27 (8-K filed 2026-11-03). Read automatically from the filings; not investment advice.
$PRG: $100M buyback authorization filed Nov 2 (8-K). Permission, not a purchase — will they execute? #buybacks #industrials
Charts: $PRG Q3 2026 (10-Q filed 2026-10-28). Read automatically from the filings; not investment advice.
$BIAFW filed a 424B5 on Nov 2: an at-the-market program of up to $5.2M. How do you read the offering — 1) growth capital 2) dilution 3) neutral? #buybacks #dividends
BREAKING: $GDRX 8-K reports non-reliance on financials (Dec 31, Mar 31, Jun 30) due to understated revenue. How do you view this — 1) noise 2) concern 3) wait for the restated financials? #8K #tech
Charts: $GDRX Q2 2026 (10-Q filed 2026-08-05). Read automatically from the filings; not investment advice.

$UNH Q3 2026: revenue $112.7B, flat Y/Y as fewer people served across health offerings were offset by pricing trends. Operating margin reached 5.8% and net earnings were $4.1B as total costs declined. #earnings #insurance

$AMD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $13.4B, +45% Y/Y, as Data Center segment revenue grew 97% on strong Instinct GPU and EPYC CPU sales. Operating margin 21.2%; net earnings $2.4B. Guides Q4 revenue to $17B. #earnings #semiconductors
$AMGN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $10.4B, +8% Y/Y, driven by volume growth across commercial products. Operating margin 35.8%; net earnings $3.9B. #earnings #biotech
$CRBG Q3 2026: revenue of $6.2B, up 14% Y/Y, driven by growth in retirement solutions and insurance products. Operating margin was 37.7%. #earnings #insurance

$JPM Q3 2026: revenue $50.2B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher net interest income from markets and deposit balances. Operating margin 40.1%; net earnings $15.3B. Operating cash flow reached $33.2B. #earnings #banks
$SMCI Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $19.9B, +298% Y/Y, driven by total AI and IT datacenter solutions. Net earnings $1.6B; operating margin 10.4%. Guides Q2 revenue to $19.5B-$21.5B. #earnings #tech

$CPNG Q3 2026: revenue $10.0B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher customer engagement despite impacts from the data incident and Incheon FC fire. Operating margin -4.5%; operating cash flow $212M. #earnings #ecommerce
$BKNG Q3 2026: revenue $8.9B, -1% Y/Y, driven by room nights up 7% as international travel improved. Operating margin 38.4%; operating cash flow $1.1B. #earnings #industrials
